Dev (CSM): Kickoff for Verdane onboarding. Short sync to lock owners, 30/60-day checkpoints, and renewal signals. Proposed Wed 14:00 PT (15m). Agenda: owners, data requirements, success metrics.
Rina (Verdane PO): Wed 14:00 PT works. Legal wants a very short item on retention + access controls.
Jon (Solutions Eng): For integration I'll need a sanitized sample schema + ~100 sample rows to validate throughput. Also: expected peak qps? If >30 qps we'll pre-provision.
Rina (Verdane PO): Peak ~18qps, steady 4-8qps. We'll send samples Mon.
Mei (Enablement): I'll run a 25-min enablement after the kickoff: 10-min demo, 10-min runbook walkthrough, 5-min Q&A. Will include masking checks and quick-play KB.
Dev (CSM): Draft success criteria to confirm in the meeting:
- Integration: staging ingest + 2 P0 flows validated within 30 days
- Observability: dashboard with 3 renewal signals (flow usage, ingest error rate, median latency)
- Enablement: recorded demo + runbook delivered
- Compliance: retention policy and masking validated
Rina (Verdane PO): Can we add "time-to-first-successful-inference" as an adoption signal? Helps our product team.
Dev (CSM): Sure — adding that as #4 for weekly health.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Quick staging auth snippet I'll use once keys are up:
```bash
export RW_API_KEY=stg-verdane-xxx
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Mei (Enablement): I'll include a short table in the runbook for masking verification steps and common ingestion errors.
Dev (CSM): Risks to capture pre-meeting: delayed sample data, retention signoff lag, quota surprises. We'll assign owners in the kickoff.
OnboardingBot: Calendar event created: "Verdane onboarding intake" Wed 14:00 PT. Invitees: Dev, Rina, Jon, Mei.
Dev (CSM): I'll post a 1-pager with pre-reqs 2 hours before and create the follow-up 30/60-day milestone doc. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
